name: Kelso Shrug
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench (30-45 degrees) holding dumbbells, arms hanging straight.
Without bending the elbows, shrug your shoulder blades up and together.
Squeeze the upper back hard at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch. This targets the mid-traps and rhomboids.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the upper back. Kelso Shrug strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
